description: This source file implements a filesystem-backed JobStore class for managing job lifecycle, metadata, and file operations within a project. It includes methods for creating jobs, updating status, saving uploads, handling errors, and retrieving job-related directories, primarily working with JSON metadata and file system paths.

classes.name: JobPaths
classes.description: Container for filesystem paths related to a specific job.

methods.name: JobCreated create_job(self, initial_status: JobState = JobState.PENDING, message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new job directory structure, initializes meta.json, and returns a JobCreated object.

methods.name: dict _read_meta(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the metadata dictionary for a specified job.

methods.name: None _write_meta(self, job_id: str, meta: dict)
methods.description: Writes a metadata dictionary to the job's meta.json file.

methods.name: JobStatus update_status( self, job_id: str, *, status: Optional[JobState] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, message: Optional[str] = None, result_url: Optional[str] = None, detections: Optional[List[PerFileDetectionSummary]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates job status, progress, message, result URL, and detections, then persists the metadata.

methods.name: JobStatus save_error(self, job_id: str, error_message: str)
methods.description: Records an error message in the job metadata and sets status to ERROR.

methods.name: JobStatus get_status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and metadata of a specified job.

methods.name: None save_uploads(self, job_id: str, drawings_zip_path: Path, logo_image_path: Path)
methods.description: Legacy helper method to save ZIP and logo image uploads for a job.

methods.name: None save_uploads_flexible( self, job_id: str, logo_image_path: Path, drawings_zip_path: Optional[Path] = None, individual_files_dir: Optional[Path] = None, )
methods.description: Supports saving logo, ZIP (with extraction), and individual files uploads into the job's upload directory, updating metadata accordingly.

methods.name: Path get_uploads_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the uploads directory for a specified job.

methods.name: Path get_work_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the work directory for a specified job.

methods.name: Path get_result_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the result directory for a specified job.

methods.name: JobStatus set_result_url(self, job_id: str, result_url: str)
methods.description: Sets the result URL in metadata for a given job and returns the updated status.

methods.name: None cleanup(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Removes the entire job directory and all its contents from the filesystem.
